notes.key_messages: Candidates are advised to: • respond to all parts of Question 2 • focus on the tenses required in Question 2, past tenses are not expected • use linking words in Question 2, for example when giving opinions/explanations • choose the option in Question 3 which allows them to show what they know • expand on the basic details of their responses in Question 3 • plan and organise answers into a coherent piece of writing, using extended sentences where possible • edit and review work carefully to avoid removing important information • present all work legibly and not to write in ink over a draft in pencil.
